correctness.rationale: The degree-two elliptic value set is represented by the square class of an explicit squarefree cubic. A root-collision count and the standard Weil bound give the stated uniform survivor estimate, and summing prefix survivor bounds yields the deterministic affine-search complexity. Finite exhaustive checks support the formulas.

originality.rationale: The motivating preprint gives a rigorous O(n q^2) affine search and an O(q^2) average estimate under an explicit heuristic independence assumption, but does not state the character-sum survivor bound or deterministic O(q^2+n q^(3/2) log q) filter. Searches found no inspected prior application yielding this refinement. Originality is only to the best of our knowledge.

value.rationale: The result replaces a heuristic pruning analysis in a recent elliptic-code structural attack with a rigorous worst-case guarantee and identifies the finite-field character structure controlling false affine normalizations, while clearly limiting the claim to that attack stage.
